text: dsh-mimo-vision-hint 是面向 DSH 的视觉提示插件：它通过 profile bundle 挂载，在系统提示中加入图片识别指引，建议 agent 使用 workflow 工具把识图任务交给 opencode-go 的 mimo-v2.5 子代理，并在调用失败时回退到 read_image。插件只注入提示，不注册模型工具或其他服务；适合希望把图片理解委派给指定视觉模型的 DSH 部署。使用前需配置 opencode-go/mimo-v2.5 提供方和 workflow 工具。

dsh-mimo-vision-hint adds image guidance to DSH system prompts. It asks agents to delegate image tasks to an opencode-go mimo-v2.5 subagent through workflow, falling back to read_image if needed. Mounted as a profile bundle, it injects prompt text only. Configure the provider and workflow tool.

如何让 agent 通过 workflow 调用图像识别子代理？

图片识别子代理调用失败时，怎样保留直接看图的后备方式？
给系统提示加上委派图片理解任务的规则。

dsh-mimo-vision-hint 的功能「图片识别委派」：系统提示建议 agent 将识图任务交给 opencode-go 的 mimo-v2.5 子代理，通过 workflow 单代理调用并指定 provider 与 model。
dsh-mimo-vision-hint 的功能「识图失败回退」：提示要求子代理调用失败时改用 read_image 直接查看图片，再向用户转述识别结果。
dsh-mimo-vision-hint 的功能「系统提示挂载」：插件在 DSH 的 systemPrompt 中注册 mimo-vision 段落；profile bundle 提供挂载入口，新增会话会获得这段识图指引。
dsh-mimo-vision-hint 的功能「统一识图提示」：作为 profile 根层的提示插件，将图片识别委派规则提供给使用该 profile 的 agent；具体子代理能力依赖 workflow 工具可用。
dsh-mimo-vision-hint 使用前须知：识图委派需要配置 opencode-go/mimo-v2.5 提供方和 workflow 工具；提示内固定指定该 provider/model，调用失败则回退到 read_image。

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · dsh-mimo-vision-hint：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A zero-dependency hint plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It registers a section in the model's system prompt instructing the agent to dispatch image-recognition tasks to an opencode-go **mimo-v2.5** subagent (a single-agent workflow with provider/model overrides) instead of reading images itself via `read_image`; if the workflow call fails, the agent falls back to `read_image`.

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · dsh-mimo-vision-hint：This plugin **only injects prompt text**: it registers no model tools and provides no cordis services, so mounting it in an agent composition needs no isolate realm.

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Prerequisites：- Your DSH deployment has a provider named **`opencode-go`** configured, serving a **`mimo-v2.5`** model — the subagent dispatch targets that provider/model pair.
- The active agent preset includes the **workflow** tool (needed to spawn the subagent).

Without these, the plugin does no harm: the injected prompt tells the agent to fall back to `read_image` directly.

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Installation：This package is a DSH **profile bundle** (its manifest declares `dsh.bundle` and it ships its own mount layer), so the official plugin command installs *and* mounts it in one step — **no hand-edited YAML required**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Isekai-Mfu/dsh-mimo-vision-hint
```

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Installation：`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile's `node_modules`, records the dependency, and — because this package declares a bundle — automatically appends its layer ([`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml), a single `insert` entry) to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` composition stack. The plugin then mounts at the host layer and takes effect for every new session of every agent preset in the deployment.

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Installation：`pnpm` must be on your PATH (`dsh plugin` forwards to it). Uninstalling is equally one command — once the dependency is gone, the bundle layer leaves the composition stack automatically:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mimo-vision-hint
```

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Manual installation (without pnpm)：1. Place this package somewhere the profile can resolve (e.g. `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-mimo-vision-hint`).
2. Add an insert entry to the profile's user patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mimo-vision
      name: dsh-mimo-vision-hint
```

3. Saving takes effect immediately (hot reload); remove the entry to disable.

dsh-mimo-vision-hint README · Notes：No other dependencies, no configuration options. The prompt text is injected into every new session; the vision subagent's provider (`opencode-go`) and model (`mimo-v2.5`) are currently hard-coded — edit `SECTION` in `lib/index.js` to change them. Presets without the workflow tool (e.g. minimal mode) cannot dispatch the subagent; the prompt tells the model to fall back to `read_image` in that case.
